description:
1. We propose to remove sections of the existing rear external walls at ground floor level, together with the existing three windows and door at ground floor level.

2. Extend the party wall between No. 72 and No. 74 in red stock brick to match the existing rear elevation.

3. Extend the party wall between No. 74 and No. 76 by 3m to the rear, also in red stock brick to match the existing rear elevation.

4. Infill the existing passageway and extend the ground floor by 3m to the rear. The extension will form the family’s new kitchen, dining room and snug, creating a more open, family-friendly and social living space.

5. Create a terrace and seating area by the rear entrance, allowing the family to make better use of their outdoor space.
